- 1 - SET

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/set/

```text
SET key value [NX | XX | IFEQ ifeq-value | IFNE ifne-value | IFDEQ ifdeq-digest | IFDNE ifdne-digest] [GET] [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]
```

- UPPERCASE = keyword you type literally.
- lowercase = placeholder; replace it with your value.
- [] = optional.
- | = OR; choose one alternative.
- Quotes ("") = group text into a single string when needed.
- Do not type the square brackets or vertical bars into the actual command.


2 - SETEX (deprecated) 

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/setex/

```text
SETEX key seconds value
```

Deprecated. Use SET with EX instead:

```redis
SET key value EX seconds
```

- 3 - SETNX (deprecated)

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/setnx/

```text
SETNX key value
```

Deprecated. Use SET with NX instead:

```redis
SET key value NX
```

1- MSET

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/mset/

```text
MSET key value [key value ...]
```

- Sets multiple key-value pairs in a single command.
- key, value = placeholders; replace them with your values.
- [] = optional.
- ... = repeat the key-value pair as needed.
- MSET overwrites existing values for the specified keys.

2 - MSETNX

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/msetnx/

```text
MSETNX key value [key value ...]
```

- Sets multiple key-value pairs only if none of the specified keys already exist.
- If any key exists, none of the pairs are set. (will not add if one of the keys already exists)

3 - MSETEX

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/msetex/

```text
MSETEX numkeys key value [key value ...] [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds]
```

- Sets multiple key-value pairs with an expiration time.
- numkeys = number of key-value pairs.
- EX = expiration in seconds; PX = expiration in milliseconds.

// will return 0 as color key already exist
MSETNX color green models tesla
